title: AI Images, Video and Voices: Module Quiz

cards.prompt: You could pause an AI image tool halfway through making "a lighthouse in a storm". What would you most likely see?

options.text: Rough shapes and colours, with no fine details yet
The top half of the picture finished, the bottom still blank
The whole finished picture, only smaller and lower quality
Pieces of real lighthouse photos waiting to be stuck together

cards.explanation: The picture is cleared from static **all over at once**, rough to fine: blobs of colour, then **rough shapes**, then details. It isn't drawn top to bottom, and it isn't stuck together from saved photos.

cards.prompt: A picture of a famous footballer eating at a small local café is spreading fast. You check it closely: normal hands, readable signs, shadows all fine.

choices.text: Share it: it passed every check for AI mistakes
choices.consequence: Good AI pictures often have no give-aways, so passing those checks proves nothing. Find out where it came from first.

choices.text: Zoom in even closer and look for smaller mistakes
choices.consequence: Still nothing odd, and still no proof either way. Staring at the picture can't tell you if it's real.

choices.text: Search with the picture to see where it first appeared
choices.consequence: It first appeared on an account that posts AI pictures, with a caption saying it was made with AI.

cards.explanation: Finding **no give-aways proves nothing**: good AI pictures often have none. Check from outside the picture: **where it first appeared**, trusted news and the account that posted it.

cards.prompt: Possible clue that a picture is AI-made, or not a clue?

items.label: A mirror reflection that doesn't match
A shop sign with jumbled letters
A grainy photo from a concert
A blurry photo of a dog running

cards.explanation: A reflection that doesn't match and jumbled letters can be AI give-aways. Grainy and blurry photos are just normal photos.

cards.prompt: A viral picture has no watermark. Your friend says that proves it's real. Are they right?

options.text: Yes: AI tools always add a watermark you can see
Yes: a hidden watermark would show up when you share it
No: marks get cropped off, and many tools add none
No: a picture with no watermark is always made by AI

cards.explanation: Watermarks get cropped, screenshots can strip hidden information saved with the file, and many tools add none. No watermark proves **nothing** either way.

cards.prompt: A video of your principal says school is closed tomorrow. It's spreading in a group chat started by someone you don't know.

steps.text: What's the best thing to do?

choices.text: Watch it again to check the lips match the words
choices.consequence: They match. Good fakes pass that test. Check with the real source instead.

choices.text: Check the school's website or ask a parent to call the school
choices.consequence: The school says it's open as normal. The video was a deepfake.

choices.text: Ask the group chat whether anyone knows if it's real
choices.consequence: People in the chat have only seen the same video. Check with the real source, another way.

cards.explanation: An unknown sender and a surprising message are **situation clues**. Check with the real source, another way: the school's website or a call.

cards.prompt: Helpful or harmful use of face and voice AI?

items.label: An author's voice cloned, with their OK
A video translated with the speaker's OK
A fake call to get bank details
A fake video of a classmate as a prank

cards.explanation: With the person's **permission** and nobody fooled, it helps. Fakes that trick or embarrass people harm.

cards.prompt: Match each situation to the right term.

pairs.left: An app turns your words into a new painting
A video shows a real singer saying words they never said
A call sounds just like your aunt, but it's AI
Hidden information in a picture file says AI made it

cards.explanation: Making something new from words is **generative AI**; a fake video of a real person is a **deepfake**; an AI copy of a voice is a **voice clone**; and a mark, visible or hidden, saying AI made it is a **watermark**.
